notes.title: Age of Barbarians Chronicles Release Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508360/f37c017cd985b3021c6b3707b7add9615f4d0e55.jpg[/img]

Dear Barbarians and supporters,

We want to share an important update regarding the release date of Age of Barbarians Chronicles. As we approach the intended launch date of November 15, we've been evaluating the current status of the game and its readiness for a successful release. After careful consideration and consultation with our marketing team, we have made the difficult decision to postpone the release.

Our marketing experts have emphasized the need for a well-planned and executed launch. Moreover, by delaying the release to a later date, we can ensure that every aspect of the game is polished, and any potential issues are addressed, providing you with a truly exceptional experience.

We understand that this news may be disappointing, but please know that it was made in the best interests of the game and our community. We value your support and want to deliver a game that is well worth the wait.

It's important to mention that Age of Barbarians Chronicles it's already available in Early Access on our Patreon platform, where you can explore it before the Steam release. Your continued support on Patreon is greatly appreciated.

https://www.patreon.com/ageofbarbarians

We apologize for any inconvenience this delay may cause and thank you for your understanding. We believe that taking the time to ensure the game is in its best possible state is the right decision for both our team and our community.

We will continue to provide updates on our progress as we work towards delivering an outstanding gaming experience.

Thank you for your patience and unwavering support.
